% Checks a case the use of a .bbl beside the document must not break:
% biblatex's bibtex backend, whose \bibdata also names the -blx.bib that
% biblatex writes into the build directory, the .bib that
% \addbibresource names, and a stale .bbl beside. bibtex runs, and the
% stale .bbl is not read.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[backend=bibtex]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{test-biblatex-authoryear.bib}
\begin{document}
A citation~\cite{book}.
\printbibliography
\end{document}
